entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The ancient, hyperintelligent dragon parun of the Izzet League on Ravnica, reborn as the Living Guildpact after the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where Niv-Mizzet lives and which he guards.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild of Ravnica founded by Niv-Mizzet, devoted to civic works, experimentation and the study of magic.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The magical pact binding Ravnica's guilds, laid down by Azor and later held by a Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon and planeswalker who slays Niv-Mizzet before the War of the Spark and invades Ravnica.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mindmage and planeswalker who was empowered as the Living Guildpact and later gave up the role.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker and Izzet mage who works for Niv-Mizzet and becomes Izzet guildmaster.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker who petrifies Isperia and later does penance for Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who undergoes penance ordered by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who allied with Bolas and controlled the God-Eternals Oketra and Bontu.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who remained loyal to Bolas.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A planeswalker who sabotages Zarek's device and whose death is later staged by Vraska.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: A sphinx petrified by Vraska at the guild summit.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A God-Eternal representing knowledge, intellect and the magic of the mind, incinerated by the reborn Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A God-Eternal obliterated by Bolas.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A God-Eternal who bites Bolas and extracts his sparks.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads the ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: A shield mage who protects the ritual participants and keeps the Chain Veil safe.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker dragon on the Meditation Plane, allied with Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who helps deliver Niv-Mizzet's spirit box to the Meditation Plane.

entities.name: Meditation Plane
entities.description: The plane where Ugin keeps Niv-Mizzet's preserved spirit.

entities.name: Firemind Vessel
entities.description: A brass model of Niv-Mizzet's head that contains his spirit when summoned.

entities.name: Operation Desperation
entities.description: The Firemind's final plan to resurrect Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Chamber of the Guildpact
entities.description: The seat of the Guildpact on Ravnica, where Niv-Mizzet resides and is resurrected.

entities.name: Interlocus
entities.description: Niv-Mizzet's experiment to absorb the power of the Guildpact.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The invasion of Ravnica by Nicol Bolas and his forces.

entities.name: Dissension
entities.description: The period when Niv-Mizzet reappeared to help Crixizix against the nephilim.

entities.name: Crixizix
entities.description: A goblin master engineer whom Niv-Mizzet helped deal with the rampant nephilim.

entities.name: Nephilim
entities.description: Ancient monstrosities that grew gargantuan after consuming a young dragon.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A detective who deciphers Kylox's research and later builds an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn.

entities.name: Etrata
entities.description: A figure contracted with Proft to assist the Omenpath Project.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who returns to Ravnica from Duskmourn after being abandoned by Jace.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A student assigned to help the Wanderer and later made an apprentice within the Omenpath Project.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A figure searching for Nashi, aided by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A person who disappeared through a mysterious doorway on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A member of the rescue party into Duskmourn.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: A member of the rescue party into Duskmourn.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The plane of the House, from which Proft and Kaito rescue the captives.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The being from whose grasp Nashi and the others are rescued.

entities.name: Omenpath Project
entities.description: Niv-Mizzet's plan to regulate Omenpaths and make Ravnica a locus of the Multiverse.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: The central dryad of Trostani, who perpetrates a string of murders.

entities.name: Kylox
entities.description: One of Niv-Mizzet's representatives, killed before completing his research.

entities.name: Lumia Voj
entities.description: A researcher under whom Zimone is assigned to work.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet defeats every rival to become the last great dragon of Ravnica.
events.quote: Having defeated an unimaginable number of challengers, the Firemind successfully purged the plane of all potential rivals to become the last great dragon of Ravnica.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet signs the Guildpact and founds the Izzet League.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet was an original signatory of the Guildpact

events.summary: During the Dissension Niv-Mizzet kills two nephilim, is struck by a projectile, and flies away to his northern aerie.
events.quote: After killing two of them, Niv-Mizzet was struck by an unforeseen projectile from one of the remaining nephilim.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet returns as a signatory for the new guildpact negotiated by Teysa Karlov.
events.quote: However, he later returned as a signatory for the new guildpact negotiated by Teysa Karlov .

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet sends Izzet mages into the Implicit Maze project, then tests Jace's authority by proposing war on the Selesnya before acknowledging his power.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet stated that the Izzet wished to declare war on the Selesnya .

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet starts the Interlocus experiment to absorb the Guildpact's power and appoints Ral Zarek acting guildleader.
events.quote: appointed Ral Zarek as acting guildleader

events.summary: At the guild summit, Niv-Mizzet asks to change the Guildpact spell to gain the power to fight Bolas; the guilds distrust his motives.
events.quote: many distrusted his motives, and the meeting was adjourned.

events.summary: Vraska petrifies Isperia, fulfilling Bolas's demands and her personal revenge, and the guilds' cooperation collapses.
events.quote: Vraska petrified the sphinx.

events.summary: Dovin Baan sabotages Zarek's device, leaving Jace as the Living Guildpact and Niv-Mizzet without the extra power.
events.quote: then sabotaged the device, leaving Jace as the Living Guildpact and Niv-Mizzet without the extra power he craved.

events.summary: As Bolas arrives, Niv-Mizzet flies off to delay him while Ral activates the Interplanar Beacon.
events.quote: Ral was sent to activate the Interplanar Beacon while the Firemind flew off to delay Bolas.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas and Niv-Mizzet fight in epic combat that destroys much of the city, and Bolas slays Niv-Mizzet, leaving only his skull and charred bones.
events.quote: In the end, Niv-Mizzet’s skull and charred bones were all that remained.

events.summary: Having allied with Ugin, Niv-Mizzet had made a device to preserve his spirit, which Sarkhan Vol delivers to the Meditation Plane.
events.quote: Having allied with Ugin , Niv-Mizzet created a device to preserve his spirit after death.

events.summary: Nissa Revane leads the guild representatives through a ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet at the ruined Chamber of the Guildpact.
events.quote: Nissa Revane led the representatives through a ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet as the new Living Guildpact .

events.summary: God-Eternal Kefnet attacks the ritual and Teyo Verada shields the participants until it is completed; Niv-Mizzet is reborn with golden scales and a decagon on his chest.
events.quote: Teyo Verada shielded the guild representatives and bystanders long enough for the ritual to be completed.

events.summary: Reborn, Niv-Mizzet incinerates Kefnet and loses consciousness from the strain.
events.quote: Upon his rebirth, the Firemind incinerated Kefnet

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet impales Bolas through the back with Hazoret's spear while Bolas is under attack; Bontu then extracts all of Bolas's sparks.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet surprised Nicol Bolas by impaling the elder dragon through the back with Hazoret's spear.

events.summary: After the war Niv-Mizzet becomes Living Guildpact in earnest and gives up the Izzet guildmastership to Ral.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet took up his new position of Living Guildpact in earnest, permanently relinquishing his status of Izzet guildmaster to Ral.

events.summary: As his first act, Niv-Mizzet sends Ral, Vraska and Kaya to hunt down Tezzeret, Dovin and Liliana as penance.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet's first act as Living Guildpact was to have Ral, Vraska , and Kaya undergo penance for allying with Bolas but defecting before the War

events.summary: At the Azorius Senate House, Kaya, Vraska and Ral report on their assignments; Ral admits Tezzeret lived and faces a failed no-confidence vote.
events.quote: the vote was unsuccessful as Ral solidified his support within the guild and remained guildmaster.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet fights in defense of Ravnica during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet fought in defense of Ravnica during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet devises the Omenpath Project and enlists guild representatives; Kylox is killed amid Oba's murders.
events.quote: The Firemind enlisted representatives from each of the guilds to research the portals and their passage.

events.summary: Proft deciphers Kylox's research and Niv-Mizzet contracts Proft and Etrata to assist the Omenpath Project.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet acknowledged his intentions and contracted the two to assist with the "Omenpath Project."

events.summary: Ral Zarek builds a relay tower in Omenport on Thunder Junction for interplanar messages.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet worked with Ral Zarek to establish interplanar communication through the Omenpaths.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet helps the Wanderer search for Nashi, whose door has appeared on Ravnica, and assigns Zimone to the party going to Duskmourn.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet assisted the Wanderer in her search for Nashi

events.summary: Kaito returns to Ravnica from Duskmourn and tells Niv-Mizzet that Jace abandoned him.
events.quote: Kaito explained that Jace Beleren had abandoned him.

events.summary: Proft creates an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn, and he and Kaito rescue Nashi, the Wanderer, Tyvar, Zimone and Niko from Valgavoth; Niv-Mizzet then releases Proft and Etrata.
events.quote: Proft successfully created an artificial Omenpath to Duskmourn

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet and Ral offer Zimone an apprenticeship in the Omenpath Project.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet and Ral Zarek extended an offer of apprenticeship to Zimone Wola
